g.text: Directed roads; L = loading, U = unloading, Q = waiting. Schematic, not physical trip acceptance.
Green: loading | Orange: unloading | Blue: waiting | Dashed red: access validation pending
Each service/waiting node has capacity 1. Retired W1/W2-local waits are excluded.
Road turns, multiple access ports and queue exclusions: ue_service_network.md + JSON catalog.
